chapter.heading: Psalm 21
The King Rejoices in the LORD’s Strength
To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
chapter.v: and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
you seta crown of fine gold upon his head.
length of days forever and ever.
splendor and majesty you bestow on him.
your right hand will find out those who hate you.
and their offspring from among the children of man.
devise mischief, they will not succeed.
aim at their faces with your bows.
We will sing and praise your power.

footnotes.footnote: 21:6 Or *make him a source of blessing forever*
